tasks.content: Initialize shadcn/ui components. Read apps/appshell/docs/how/MIGRATION-v0.1-to-v2.md section 'Task O: shadcn/ui Init'. This is the sequential blocker task. Execute: `cd apps/appshell/app && npx shadcn-ui@latest init --defaults --tailwind ./tailwind.config.ts --utils ./src/lib/utils.ts --cwd . && npx shadcn-ui@latest add button card dropdown-menu separator form`. This creates src/lib/utils.ts with cn() helper and src/components/ui/ directory with 5 components. Verify: src/components/ui/button.tsx exists and exports Button component.

Rename src/index.tsx to src/main.tsx and rewrite with providers. Read apps/appshell/docs/how/MIGRATION-v0.1-to-v2.md section 'Task A'. Update index.html to point to /src/main.tsx. Wrap App with ThemeProvider (next-themes), QueryClientProvider, and BrowserRouter. Initialize MSW with condition: `if (__ENABLE_MSW__ && import.meta.env.DEV)`. Copy pattern from MIGRATION guide. Keep existing App component import and structure. Verify: file exists at correct path, renders without errors.

Rename src/main.css to src/styles/globals.css and update for next-themes dark mode. Read MIGRATION-v0.1-to-v2.md section 'Task B'. Move file to src/styles/ directory (create if needed). Update CSS to use .dark class selector for dark mode instead of data-theme attribute. Update import in main.tsx to './styles/globals.css'. Preserve existing light mode variables and transitions. Verify: file path correct, .dark selector present for dark mode support.
Create .env.example at apps/appshell/app/.env.example. Read MIGRATION-v0.1-to-v2.md section 'Task P'. Content: VITE_APP_NAME=AppShell. This documents required environment variables for the project.

Update tailwind.config.ts to support shadcn/ui and dark mode. Read MIGRATION-v0.1-to-v2.md section 'Task S'. Verify darkMode is set to 'class'. Ensure content paths include src/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}. Check theme.extend.colors if shadcn colors need defining. If file already has correct config, verify and commit without changes. Verify: darkMode: 'class' is set, content patterns correct for Tailwind to find all component files.

Create vitest.config.ts at apps/appshell/app/vitest.config.ts. Read MIGRATION-v0.1-to-v2.md section 'Task Q'. Set up Vitest with react plugin, jsdom environment, and vitest.setup.ts. Include @/ path alias pointing to src. Copy pattern from MIGRATION guide exactly. Verify: file created with correct config, globals enabled, environment set to jsdom, setupFiles points to vitest.setup.ts.

Create vitest.setup.ts at apps/appshell/app/vitest.setup.ts. Read MIGRATION-v0.1-to-v2.md section 'Task R'. Import Testing Library cleanup and matchers. Set up MSW setupServer with existing handlers from src/mocks/handlers (create if missing). Add beforeAll, afterEach, afterAll hooks for MSW lifecycle. Copy pattern from MIGRATION guide. Verify: file created, MSW server setup correct, cleanup functions present.

Rename src/pages/ directory to src/screens/ and rename all Page components. Read MIGRATION-v0.1-to-v2.md section 'Task C'. In apps/appshell/app: Move src/pages/HomePage.tsx → src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx. Move src/pages/AboutPage.tsx → src/screens/AboutScreen.tsx. Move src/pages/HelpPage.tsx → src/screens/HelpScreen.tsx. Delete src/pages/UsersPage.tsx and src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx (not in target structure). Update all import paths in App.tsx and any other files that reference these pages. Keep file contents unchanged (renaming only, no logic changes except import paths).

Rename src/lib/queryClient.ts to src/lib/query-client.ts. Read MIGRATION-v0.1-to-v2.md section 'Task G'. Keep file content unchanged. Update imports in main.tsx to use new path: `import queryClient from './lib/query-client'`. Verify: file path correct, content preserved, imports updated in main.tsx.

Create src/lib/utils.ts with cn() helper. Read MIGRATION-v0.1-to-v2.md section 'Task H'. If shadcn init (Task O) already created this file, verify it exists with correct exports. If not present, create with: import clsx, twMerge, and export cn() function. Content: export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) { return twMerge(clsx(inputs)); }. Verify: file exists at correct path, cn() function exported and usable.

Create src/lib/schemas/.gitkeep directory marker. Read MIGRATION-v0.1-to-v2.md section 'Task I'. This reserves the directory for future Zod schema definitions. Create empty .gitkeep file in src/lib/schemas/ to preserve directory in git.

Refactor HomeScreen.tsx (renamed from HomePage.tsx by Task C). Read MIGRATION-v0.1-to-v2.md section 'Task D'. File now at src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx. Replace any inline Card layout with Card from shadcn/ui: `import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card'`. Use cn() from @/lib/utils.ts for conditional Tailwind classes. Keep component logic and routing intact. Verify: imports correct, Card components from shadcn/ui used, cn() available for class composition.

Move AboutScreen.tsx (renamed from AboutPage.tsx by Task C). Read MIGRATION-v0.1-to-v2.md section 'Task E'. File now at src/screens/AboutScreen.tsx. No logic changes, file content preserved as-is. Verify: file at correct path, component intact.

Move HelpScreen.tsx (renamed from HelpPage.tsx by Task C). Read MIGRATION-v0.1-to-v2.md section 'Task F'. File now at src/screens/HelpScreen.tsx. No logic changes, file content preserved as-is. Verify: file at correct path, component intact.

Clean src/stores/appStore.ts — remove all theme logic. Read MIGRATION-v0.1-to-v2.md section 'Task J'. Delete theme-related state and methods (setTheme, theme property, etc). Keep file structure for future app state (sidebar, auth, etc). If file becomes empty after removing theme logic, replace entire content with `.gitkeep` marker or minimal comment. Verify: theme logic removed, file structure preserved for future use.

Delete src/hooks/useTheme.ts. Read MIGRATION-v0.1-to-v2.md section 'Task K'. Remove this file entirely as next-themes provides its own useTheme() hook. Update any imports of this hook to use `import { useTheme } from 'next-themes'` instead. Check ThemeToggle.tsx and any other components using useTheme. Verify: file deleted, all imports switched to next-themes.

Rewrite src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx using next-themes and lucide-react. Read MIGRATION-v0.1-to-v2.md section 'Task L'. Replace custom Zustand logic with useTheme() from next-themes. Import icons from lucide-react (Sun, Moon, Monitor). Use shadcn/ui Button and DropdownMenu components. Code pattern provided in MIGRATION guide. Theme options: system, light, dark. Icons change based on current theme. Verify: useTheme() from next-themes used, lucide icons imported, Button and DropdownMenu from shadcn/ui.

Refactor src/components/layout/Header.tsx — replace inline SVGs with lucide-react icons. Read MIGRATION-v0.1-to-v2.md section 'Task M'. Find all inline <svg> elements in Header component. Replace with lucide-react imports: Menu, X, Home, etc. Update icon className to h-6 w-6 or appropriate size. Keep component structure and styling intact. Verify: inline SVGs removed, lucide icons imported and used, component renders correctly.

Refactor src/components/layout/Footer.tsx — replace inline SVGs with lucide-react icons. Read MIGRATION-v0.1-to-v2.md section 'Task N'. Find all inline <svg> elements in Footer component. Replace with lucide-react imports. Update icon sizes as needed. Keep component structure and styling intact. Verify: inline SVGs removed, lucide icons imported and used, component renders correctly.
